who: Bogdan Popa is an individual architect based in Bucharest and Constanța, Romania, offering civil and industrial construction design, interior arrangements, urban planning, and specialty consulting services through his private practice.
fit_reason: While Bogdan Popa is a Romanian architect operating in mid-size cities (Bucharest counts as major, Constanța is mid-size), there is no evidence in the source that he specifically targets or serves the Romanian diaspora abroad. His practice appears to be locally focused, with no mention of international clients, remote project management, or services tailored to non-resident clients. The ICP requires active engagement with diaspora clients building homes in Romania — this profile lacks any signal of that niche.
